messages:
maria: Hey team — I opened a PR that rewrites the 'Rate limits & quotas' section. Main changes: clarify tiered burst credits, add an embeddings-specific examples subsection, and replace the old Python SDK examples.
alex: Thanks — can you paste the new SDK snippet here? I want to sanity-check the usage for async batching.
maria: Sure. New minimal snippet for the JavaScript SDK (async generator):
```js
const resp = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-embed-002', input: 'hello' });
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.output_text || '');
}
```
This replaces the old `.createEmbedding` example.
jin: For the pricing table, did we keep the per-embedding-unit line and add the burst-credit examples? I remember the audit flagged an ambiguity between "unit" and "request".
maria: Yes — I added a short paragraph + table row showing: "1 embedding unit = 1 vector call up to 4096 tokens" and an inline example showing cost calc.
samir: Quick localization note: the new wording uses "embedding unit" — localization team prefers a glossary term. Can we add a parenthetical (see glossary) so translators are consistent?
maria: Good call, @samir — I'll add `(see glossary: embedding unit)`.
doc-bot: PR #4231 opened by maria: docs/rate-limits-rewrite — CI: docs-build ✅, linkcheck ❌ (1 broken link)
alex: Linkcheck failure — where? I can fix if it's in the SDK link anchor.
maria: It's the anchors on the billing dashboard panel. The link points to /docs/dashboard#metering-panels but the canonical changed to /docs/observability#metering-panels. I'll update the link.
jin: Also, minor nit: in the 'Burst credits' example we show math using 2 decimal places. Finance prefers rounding to 4 decimal places for per-token cost. Could we show both? e.g., raw and rounded.
maria: Will add both values in the example and note rounding rule. Also adding a short test snippet for the samples folder so we can run the example with the emulator.

maria: Final checklist before I request review: update dashboard anchor, add glossary parenthetical, include JS streaming snippet, add Python sync equivalent, add localization note. Anything else?
samir: Add a short blurb for Dedicated customers about reserved capacity behavior (they don't use burst credits).

alex: I'll do a quick pass on the JS snippet for style and ping reviewers. If someone can fix the link, merge once CI is clean.
maria: Thanks! I'll push the link fix in a follow-up commit in 30m. :thumbsup:
